page_title: BET 2-1 LEV | Betis v Levante 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Mateo Busquets has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' None of the Levante players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle and it's Ugo Raghouber (Levante) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Antony (Betis), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
86' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
86' The substitution has been made. Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) has replaced Pablo Martinez Andres.
85' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
82' Tai Abed (Levante) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Adrian, who smothers the ball.
80' The attendance is 45318.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alvaro Fidalgo (Betis) is coming onto the pitch as Pablo Fornals cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' That will be all from Abde Ezzalzouli who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Chimy Avila (Betis).
79' Here's the change. Natan leaves the pitch and Valentin Gomez (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
78' Here is a change. Ivan Romero is going off and Luis Castro gives the last tactical orders to Iker Losada (Levante).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ugo Raghouber (Levante) comes onto the pitch for Jon Ander Olasagasti.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
76' Dangerous play by Diego Llorente (Betis). Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Levante comes to nothing.
72' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
71' Although Luis Castro (Levante) is just on the bench, Mateo Busquets has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
70' Referee Mateo Busquets signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Betis players have a reason to celebrate!
70' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Betis players aren’t happy.
68' 2 - 1 Goal! Pablo Fornals (Betis) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:1.
67' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Jeremy Toljan (Levante), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
64' Referee Mateo Busquets sees the trip by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
61' Corner kick. Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is ready to send the ball into the box.
61' Ivan Romero (Levante) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Levante will take a corner kick.
57' Marc Roca (Betis) brings his opponent down. Mateo Busquets has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
54' It will be a substitution. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Isco walks off.

53' Tai Abed (Levante) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
53' Betis take a short corner kick.

53' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Betis will have a corner.
52' There's an opportunity for Antony (Betis) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

52' Diego Llorente (Betis) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Mathew Ryan has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
49' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.

48' Adrian was forced into action to thwart Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
47' Tai Abed (Levante) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' The game is over for Kareem Tunde. Tai Abed (Levante) comes on for the second half.
46' Luis Castro makes a switch. Oriol Rey (Levante) is coming on in place of Kervin Arriaga at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Mateo Busquets has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Levante have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+4' Mateo Busquets blows the whistle, Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) is penalised for a foul.
45+1' 1 - 1 Carlos Espi (Levante) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' A pass from Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is intercepted by Adrian and the move breaks down.
41' Some great controlled play and passing from Betis. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
37' The foul by Kervin Arriaga (Levante) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mateo Busquets.
37' The resulting set piece from Levante is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Adrian keeps it out with an amazing save. Levante win a corner.
37' Carlos Espi (Levante) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
35' Betis enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
34' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
30' Kareem Tunde (Levante) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' The referee blows for a cooling break.
25' Isco (Betis) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
22' The expression of the referee Mateo Busquets is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Antony (Betis) is shown a yellow card.
20' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Cucho Hernandez (Betis) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
17' Kareem Tunde (Levante) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Adrian makes a comfortable save.
16' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
16' Levante can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Levante. Now Levante have a corner.
14' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle after Antony (Betis) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
11' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for an infringement.
9' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

5' 1 - 0 Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) scores a goal after nicely controlling a pass and unleashing a powerful close-range shot into the bottom right corner. The keeper couldn't do anything to stop this wonderful effort.
3' Antony (Betis) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
2' Ivan Romero (Levante) jumps into a tackle and Mateo Busquets signals a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Levante will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Mateo Busquets.
